messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "individuals younger than 18 years old with breathing problems"
set: ["individuals younger than 18 years old with breathing problems", "individuals younger than 18 years old", "patients younger than 18 years old", "children younger than 18 years old", "children younger than 12 years old", "children younger than 6 years old", "children younger than 7 years old", "children younger than 4 years old", "children younger than 5 years old", "children younger than 2 years old", "children younger than 10 years old", "do not give to anyone younger than 18 years old without doctor's advice", "avoid use in children younger than 12 years old", "children younger than 6 months old", "anyone younger than 1 month old", "patients with breathing problems"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
